> {{ site.description }}

The Spectroscopy and AI Lab (SAIL), led by {{ site.data.pi.name }} ({{ site.data.pi.name_ko }}), {{ site.data.pi.title }} in the {{ site.data.pi.department }} at {{ site.data.pi.institution }}, integrates machine learning with chemistry. Website: {{ site.url }}

## Key pages
- [Research]({{ site.url }}/research/): the lab's research directions, each with a figure from the lab's own papers.
- [Publications]({{ site.url }}/publications/): {{ site.data.publications | size }} papers; each has a detail page at {{ site.url }}/publications/<id>/ with abstract and DOI.
- [Members]({{ site.url }}/members/) and [Alumni]({{ site.url }}/alumni/): lab people, each with a page at {{ site.url }}/people/<slug>/.
- [Principal Investigator]({{ site.url }}/pi/): {{ site.data.pi.name }}.
- [News]({{ site.url }}/news/): lab updates and milestones.
- [Positions]({{ site.url }}/positions/): how to join the lab and how to apply (postdoctoral researcher, PhD student, and undergraduate research), including currently advertised undergraduate projects. Written in Korean.

Each entry links its page on this site, in the llms.txt list form "[name](url): notes"; brackets in a title (e.g. [4+2]) are escaped so the link stays intact.{% endcomment -%}
